Know More © Salman Khan Films Sharad Kapoor has been making headlines for the various problems he is going through at the moment. Although he denied having any financial issues,  Salman Khan and Sonu Sood have stepped in to support him as well. In the midst of it all, the Josh actor is also looking for work, specifically for OTT platforms.
 Now, not only is he getting help from the biggest and most influential people in Bollywood, but he’s also gearing up for a Hollywood debut.
 Sharad Kapoor is Getting Aid from Everywhere 
 © Instagram/the__sharadkapoor 
 Sharad Kapoor had openly appealed to Bollywood to get him work after his four dogs were taken away by animal welfare. His living conditions, alongside his health problems, made it impossible for him and his family to care for the four pets, especially with a newborn baby to take care of.
 This had many wondering if he was going through a tough financial phase. As per ABP News, Salman Khan has stepped up to offer financial aid and  Sonu Sood has also sent a team of doctors to deal with Kapoor’s leg injury, which he got when playing football in Barcelona. Khan will also continue to provide him with finances.
 Both Sood and Salman have been philanthropic in helping people in need on various occasions. 
 Sharad had previously made an appeal, “ Kripaya meri madad karen. Mujhe kaam ki zaroorat hai. Mai apne sabhi senior actors aur apne sabhi boss se appeal karta hoon ki please meri madad kijiye. Mai apne sabhi actors ka bahut bada fan hoon aur unhone hamesha hero ki nazar se dekhta hoon. (Please help me. I need work. I request all my senior actors to ask their bosses to help me. I’m a big fan of all actors and have always seen them like heroes.)”
 In an interview with Hindustan Times, he also revealed that having lived in New York for at least seven years, the actor is all set to make his Hollywood debut as well. 
 “If we badmouth each other, it gives the public a reason to badmouth us too. I’ve already got an offer for a Hollywood film, which I’m going to start in January. I am also going to continue working on Bollywood projects. This is my country. As soon as I recover fully in two months, things will get back on track.”
 The filming is reportedly set to begin in January for the same.
